text:
inc-bot: PagerDuty alert P0 - gpu-node-5 prefills hitting OOM (containers restarting)

pagerduty: Alert details: service=runtime-prefill, severity=critical, affected_zone=us-west-2, approx 12% of requests failing with container restarts

sre-oncall: oncall here, taking ownership. @alice @dinesh please ack and paste any recent logs you have.

alice: ack, I'm on it. seeing spike in long-context requests from a customer test harness ~2m ago.

dinesh: attaching agent logs from node-5: 
```
[2026-03-17T02:14:03Z] container runtime: oom-kill: process killed due to OOM
[2026-03-17T02:14:04Z] container restart: exit_code=137 image=redwood/runtime:release-2026.03
[2026-03-17T02:14:05Z] prefill_size=1.2M tokens, seq_len=65536, gpu_mem=44824MiB/49152MiB
```

carla: confirmed - prefill size huge, kv-cache reaching capacity then cuda OOM. node telemetry shows KV fragmentation.

ml-runtime: hypothesis: a long-prompt loadtest triggered worst-case kvcache allocation + continuous prefill (no trimming). Suggest temporary mitigations: 1) enable prefill_trim=true globally for that pool, 2) route high-seq requests to smaller-context model/quantized fallback, 3) reduce prefetch concurrency.

eva: customer impact? do we have failing user requests reported?

alice: customer-facing metrics: error-rate spike on hosted API /v1/generate in us-west-2 at 02:13, ~6% requests 500'ing. Most from a single API key (internal test).

sre-oncall: immediate actions I can take: cordon node-5, move traffic off hotpool, scale up standby nodes, and enable prefill_trim. Which do we prefer first?

dinesh: enable prefill_trim on cluster-pool-usw2 now. It will lower memory per prefill by trimming long prefixes. Risk: slightly different outputs for those long-context calls. :warning:

ml-runtime: also recommend activating model-fallback-policy: prefer small-context variant (model-x-small) for seq_len > 32k. That will buy headroom without infra churn.

sre-oncall: doing steps now: 1) toggling prefill_trim=true for pool (patch applied), 2) updating routing policy to prefer model-x-small for seq>32k, 3) cordoning node-5 (no new pods).

carla: logs after toggle: 
```
[2026-03-17T02:15:10Z] prefill_trim enabled for pool=cluster-pool-usw2
[2026-03-17T02:15:11Z] pending requests rerouted: 42 -> model-x-small
[2026-03-17T02:15:12Z] node-5: no new pods scheduled, 3 active containers draining
```

alice: seeing reduced OOMs immediately. error-rate dropping to 1.2% in last 3m.

dinesh: triggered a hotswap to increase kv-cache eviction aggressiveness as additional guard.

ml-runtime: nice — follow-up: schedule a canary of a quantized variant (int8) for heavy-prefill traffic and add a metric alert for prefill_trim_rate and fallback_ratio.

sre-oncall: I'm still seeing 2 containers restart during drain (probably older pods). I'm going to evict them and force-recreate on other nodes.

carla: grabbing the restart stacktrace for one of the crashed containers: 
```
runtime error: CUD A out of memory at allocate() kernel.cu:423
signal 6: Aborted (core dumped)
backtrace: 0x7f8a... 0x55b3...
```

eva: customer comms: flagging internal test key as likely root cause, reaching out to customer ops to confirm. No broad customer degradation reported beyond US-WEST test traffic.

alice: cust ops confirmed it's an internal partner test. They will throttle tests and follow runbook limits for seq lengths.

sre-oncall: Given stabilization, I'm changing incident state to "mitigated". Still keeping node cordoned for 30m and monitoring.

dinesh: opening a follow-up ticket: RUNTIME-4567 - Investigate KV cache fragmentation and add prefill safety caps per API key.

ml-runtime: action items: 1) implement per-request prefill hard cap (e.g., 48k tokens) + opt-in extended window, 2) add fallback routing rule in control plane, 3) test eviction policy changes in staging.

eva: drafting customer note: short postmortem with mitigation steps, impact (6% error spike window 02:13-02:16 UTC, limited to one API key), and recommended guardrails for partner tests.

sre-oncall: final check: CPU/GPU utilization back to normal across region, error-rate at baseline. I'll hand off to daytime SRE for post-incident reviews.

alice: thanks team. filing for postmortem and scheduling incident review. :white_check_mark:

inc-bot: Incident P0 - runtime-prefill stabilized. Tags: pref il-oom, cuda, kvcache, mitigation, postmortem-required

pagerduty: Incident resolved ack received from oncall.
